title: EDG Community Update: Dec 20th - Jan 2nd 2022
body:
**Highlights**
- [A referendum was proposed to fund Kabocha’s Technical Stewardship](https://twitter.com/HeyKabocha/status/1475109433848090629?s=20) from the on-chain treasury.
- [Rosetta-API integration](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1473125825583144960?s=20) is now production-ready.
- [The waitlist is now open for Kabocha](https://www.kabocha.network/), the Kusama parachain candidate from the Edgeware ecosystem.
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases) to proceed further with the ERUP4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance. The core community dev Ramsey recently shared [the docker image for v3.3.3 aka ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1438226365833175048?s=20) to save the compiling hustle for node/validator owners.
- Get to know more technical oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-dec-18th/)’.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Ecosystem contributor [Junte added Atomic Swap’s pallet](https://twitter.com/Madtodist/status/1472934933287129092?s=20) in the upcoming ERUP5 upgrade, opening up the way to swap between $EDG, $KLP and $Neat.
- Community Treasury-funded Web3 Media platform, [New-Futures have opened up pre-registrations](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1469353591433478150?s=20) for their highly anticipated upcoming launch.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.


**Governance**
- Referendum #53: [Kabocha Technical Steward - Treasury Proposal](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/2515-kabocha-technical-steward-treasury-proposal/) {Referendum type: SimpleMajority, Council Motion:60, Treasury Proposal ID:4
